Drop acoustic hi-hat / cymbal / shaker recordings here as .wav files
(8/16/24/32-bit PCM or 32-bit float, mono or stereo, any sample rate, up to 3 s).

They are loaded in filename order after the five built-in sounds
(CHAT, OHAT, PEDAL, SHAKR, RIDE) and show up on the SYNTH page under
HAT > SAMPLE, using the first 6 letters of the filename.
